facts.fact: Malawi's Ministry of Gender, Community Development and Social Welfare issued the National Disability Policy 2025, whose Accessibility priority area commits the government to ensure information and communication materials in accessible formats and to promote access to public information by persons with disabilities, with an implementation plan for 2025-2028.

facts.fact: Malawi's Persons with Disabilities Act 2024 (Act No. 4 of 2024, assented 31 January 2024, commenced 5 April 2024 per the file's note) section 30 gives persons with disabilities a right to access information and communication technologies and requires anyone publishing information to the public to also publish it in an accessible format, including sign language and braille.
